title: Recover a durable Pending acceptance submission after its evaluator ends
outcome: A durable Pending evaluator write left after a host restart has a supported recovery decision without changing its retained actor, payload or attempt identity.
acceptance: A behavioral restart fixture demonstrates the durable Pending state on an ended evaluator and its current recovery refusal.
A supported recovery route or explicit product decision handles that state without creating a fresh judgment or changing the retained actor, payload or attempt key.
Focused behavioral tests cover admission, refusal and duplicate handling for the chosen recovery behavior.
